sql: WITH overall_median AS (SELECT p50 AS overall_median_pay FROM mart_comp_by_family WHERE family IS NULL AND seniority IS NULL), seniority_median AS (SELECT seniority, p50 AS median_pay FROM mart_comp_by_family WHERE family IS NULL AND seniority IS NOT NULL) SELECT sm.seniority, sm.median_pay, sm.median_pay - om.overall_median_pay AS difference_from_overall_median FROM seniority_median AS sm CROSS JOIN overall_median AS om ORDER BY sm.median_pay DESC
